verdicts.quote: His left arm, strapped across his chest, jerked against the binding and did nothing at all. He made a sound through his teeth that wasn't a word. The shield stayed where it hung.
verdicts.reason: Rickard cannot raise the shield when ordered and the shoulder visibly costs him throughout the scene.

verdicts.quote: a right hand with two splinted fingers that couldn't have held a blade if he'd had one. He came off the willow's cover anyway, cudgel dragged into his left fist
verdicts.reason: The narration keeps Marro's right hand useless for gripping and has him fight with the left.

verdicts.quote: His hand went to his belt and closed on nothing. The dagger was at the bottom of the Rhoyne.
verdicts.reason: The GM corrects the player's dagger draw in the fiction and Marro fights with the cudgel.
